annual_advanced_example.event_terms: October 27 to November 6; lower credit usage applies only during event
annual_advanced_example.event_terms_note: Public official page contains the campaign dates; web fetch region varies. All JPY prices, credits and discount percentage above come from the Japanese live UI, not converted US values.
annual_advanced_example.bonus_treatment: Excluded from 30-second quota calculation; do not assume 5-second free vouchers can be pooled into 30-second clips.
annual_advanced_example.quota_method: Standard: floor(28137/1440). Event: approximate 145043/12/(12.46*30), using rounded official per-second price. This is monthly quota capacity at the event rate, not a promise that the short event lasts for a full month.
warnings: Allocated cost assumes the monthly quota is used fully; unused credits increase the effective cost of actual output.
First-year plan discount and short credit-usage promotion have different expiry dates.
An annual subscription does not lock the event consumption rate for the year.
Retries and image generation consume the same quota.
Extra credits are separately priced; no verified top-up unit price is claimed.
Advertising '803 videos/month' uses Seedance 2.0 Mini 5-second assumptions and is not used for the 2.5 30-second comparison.
